business_problem: Agnes AI redefines everyday AI on Google Cloud with Gemini, breaking data silos to deliver scalable, high-frequency, multimodal AI for everyone.
solution_summary: With Gemini , Agnes AI evolves from an "AI tool" into an "AI Native Snap" platform enabling high-frequency, everyday AI experiences Agnes AI is an AI-native collaborative workspace platform headquartered in Singapore, focused on integration across both the foundation model and the application. Its brand mission is to bring AI's capabilities into an all-in-one application that spans productivity, entertainment, and social interaction-so AI is no longer a tool that is passively invoked, but something that naturally integrates into broader scenarios of everyday life and work. Designed for everyday use by ordinary people, this vision led Agnes AI to define a new positioning: "AI Native Snap." As Agnes AI pursued its vision of building an "AI Native Snap" platform, it became clear that the real challenge lay in the underlying architecture. Under its previous traditional cloud setup, data silos were the core limitation.
